name: slot_on_narrow_plate_90
why: The twin of the zero-degree case, and it is THIS one that sees the rotation. On the plate 40 wide the slot turned by 90 degrees sticks out by 5.5 mm from both sides -- y from -25.5 to +25.5 against a half-height of 20 -- and the two end caps fall outside: the 40 x 11 rectangle remains. If the rotation were not applied, this case and the zero-degree one would give THE SAME NUMBER.

expect.tolerance_why: 160000 minus the 40 x 11 x 20 rectangle alone = 8800. The two caps fall outside the material: the cubic millimetre covers the way SOLIDWORKS cuts on the edge
